topics.headline: Iran war escalates as US casualties climb and strikes hit base in Jordan
topics.snippet: Data obtained through a Freedom of Information Act request to the Defense Manpower Data Center indicates more than 400 US service members have died in the war with Iran. An Iranian ballistic missile s…
topics.text:
iran war escalates as us casualties climb and strikes hit base in jordan
data obtained through a freedom of information act request to the defense manpower data center indicates more than 400 us service members have died in the war with iran. an iranian ballistic missile struck a united states base in jordan overnight, and iran also launched a surprise attack on american bases elsewhere in the middle east despite claims that negotiations were being pursued. china is reported to be supplying iran with roughly 400 air defense missile launchers valued at $60 million to $70 million. president trump responded with profane language and said the united states would strike iran extremely hard.

topics.headline: Epstein survivors deliver files to senators ahead of Todd Blanche vote
topics.snippet: More than ten Epstein survivors went office to office on Capitol Hill delivering copies of the Epstein files to Republican and Democratic senators on the Judiciary Committee. The visits included the o…
topics.text:
epstein survivors deliver files to senators ahead of todd blanche vote
more than ten epstein survivors went office to office on capitol hill delivering copies of the epstein files to republican and democratic senators on the judiciary committee. the visits included the offices of senators katie britt, mike lee, josh hawley and john kennedy. the survivors are urging senators to vote no on todd blanche's confirmation, scheduled for the following day, and say they will continue pressing the issue regardless of the outcome.

topics.headline: Trump loses ground on SAVE Act, filibuster and birthright citizenship appeal
topics.snippet: Senate Majority Leader John Thune confirmed Republicans do not have the votes to pass the SAVE Act or to eliminate the filibuster, and currently lack the votes to move the measure through budget recon…
topics.text:
trump loses ground on save act, filibuster and birthright citizenship appeal
senate majority leader john thune confirmed republicans do not have the votes to pass the save act or to eliminate the filibuster, and currently lack the votes to move the measure through budget reconciliation. as it stands, the save act has no path to passage before the november elections. separately, trump's legal team missed the deadline to ask the supreme court for a rehearing in his birthright citizenship case, foreclosing that request.

topics.headline: Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment throughout congressional testimony
topics.snippet: Anthony Fauci declined to answer questions at a congressional hearing, repeatedly invoking his Fifth Amendment rights on the advice of counsel. Questions he declined to answer included whether he was…
topics.text:
fauci invokes fifth amendment throughout congressional testimony
anthony fauci declined to answer questions at a congressional hearing, repeatedly invoking his fifth amendment rights on the advice of counsel. questions he declined to answer included whether he was aware of gain-of-function research on monkeypox at the national biodefense analysis and countermeasures center and fort detrick, and whether the cia transferred funds to the nih under an interagency agreement. one of his attorneys was ordered removed from the room after the chair said he had been told not to sit at the witness table and was being disruptive. lawmakers also pressed fauci on past remarks about making life difficult for people who declined covid vaccination.

topics.headline: CENTCOM warns troop videos could help Iran target US bases
topics.snippet: The top US Middle East commander warned troops that videos they share online can help Iran assess the effects of its strikes on American bases. Sources said phone confiscations and other restrictions…
topics.text:
centcom warns troop videos could help iran target us bases
the top us middle east commander warned troops that videos they share online can help iran assess the effects of its strikes on american bases. sources said phone confiscations and other restrictions on personal device use are being considered.

topics.headline: Defense Department post shows AI prompt asking to build an agent to generate a war
topics.snippet: An official post from the Department of War's account, attributed to the Undersecretary of Research and Engineering, described new AI task forces embedded within the US Pacific Fleet. An image include…
topics.text:
defense department post shows ai prompt asking to build an agent to generate a war
an official post from the department of war's account, attributed to the undersecretary of research and engineering, described new ai task forces embedded within the us pacific fleet. an image included in the post shows a service member's exchange with an ai chatbot in which the prompt reads, "i need help building an agent to generate a war." commentators questioned whether the detail was deliberate trolling or an operational security lapse.

topics.headline: CENTCOM says Iranian ballistic missile attack on U.S. forces intercepted
topics.snippet: U.S. Central Command said Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces launched multiple ballistic missiles from Iran at 5:45 p.m. ET on July 28 in what it described as an attempted surprise attack on U.S…
topics.text:
centcom says iranian ballistic missile attack on u.s. forces intercepted
u.s. central command said islamic revolutionary guard corps forces launched multiple ballistic missiles from iran at 5:45 p.m. et on july 28 in what it described as an attempted surprise attack on u.s. forces based in the middle east. centcom said all of the missiles were successfully intercepted and that u.s. forces remain at a high state of readiness. no casualties or damage were reported.

topics.headline: Trump hosts Netanyahu and Zelenskyy as both leaders attend Graham funeral
topics.snippet: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy travelled to Washington on July 28 for separate one-on-one meetings with President Donald Trump, with the White Ho…
topics.text:
trump hosts netanyahu and zelenskyy as both leaders attend graham funeral
israeli prime minister benjamin netanyahu and ukrainian president volodymyr zelenskyy travelled to washington on july 28 for separate one-on-one meetings with president donald trump, with the white house saying the two visits were not a joint session. both leaders also attended the funeral of senator lindsey graham, who had close ties to each and had recently returned from a trip to ukraine before his death. the visits come as the wars involving iran and ukraine reach critical stages, and critics noted that netanyahu is subject to an international criminal court arrest warrant.

topics.headline: Trump's conduct at Lindsey Graham funeral draws scrutiny
topics.snippet: Footage from Lindsey Graham's funeral showed President Trump appearing to struggle to stay awake and, by some observers' accounts, dozing off for minutes at a time during the proceedings, including wh…
topics.text:
trump's conduct at lindsey graham funeral draws scrutiny
footage from lindsey graham's funeral showed president trump appearing to struggle to stay awake and, by some observers' accounts, dozing off for minutes at a time during the proceedings, including while graham's niece delivered a eulogy. trump also departed from his prepared remarks, saying that although the written text described graham as liked by virtually everyone in washington, "not everybody" actually liked him. in the same eulogy he said graham had his heart in his work "until it literally gave out." at 80, trump is the oldest president in american history.

topics.headline: Trump said to be weighing his own mortality after Graham's death
topics.snippet: According to the Washington Post, Trump has been discussing his own mortality more frequently behind the scenes since Lindsey Graham's sudden death. He has reportedly raised concerns that Graham's hea…
topics.text:
trump said to be weighing his own mortality after graham's death
according to the washington post, trump has been discussing his own mortality more frequently behind the scenes since lindsey graham's sudden death. he has reportedly raised concerns that graham's heavy travel schedule may have contributed to his declining health and has looked into graham's family history for possible genetic factors. trump, 80, has two years remaining in his second term.

topics.headline: FIFA plan to hand World Cup company to Kushner-backed investors sparks backlash
topics.snippet: FIFA president Gianni Infantino announced a plan to create a $20 billion private company, backed by the Kushner family alongside other private investors, to run the World Cup. The proposal, first repo…
topics.text:
fifa plan to hand world cup company to kushner-backed investors sparks backlash
fifa president gianni infantino announced a plan to create a $20 billion private company, backed by the kushner family alongside other private investors, to run the world cup. the proposal, first reported by the financial times, drew immediate objections from uefa, which said "it's not fifa's to sell" and that "none of us are the owners of football." trump has separately said he wants infantino appointed united nations secretary general.

topics.headline: ICE expands airport arrests of travellers with expired visas
topics.snippet: According to the New York Times, ICE is escalating stops and arrests at U.S. airports, prioritising travellers whose visas have expired, in a new level of cooperation with the TSA that did not previou…
topics.text:
ice expands airport arrests of travellers with expired visas
according to the new york times, ice is escalating stops and arrests at u.s. airports, prioritising travellers whose visas have expired, in a new level of cooperation with the tsa that did not previously exist. the practice has been documented on at least a dozen occasions and affects people flying domestically, including those awaiting green cards or visa extensions. hundreds of thousands of people who have overstayed visas could now be detained while travelling.

topics.headline: More than 12,000 arrested using child migrant agency data
topics.snippet: A Reuters investigation found that more than 12,000 people were arrested after the U.S. agency responsible for unaccompanied child migrants shared leads with Immigration and Customs Enforcement. The d…
topics.text:
more than 12,000 arrested using child migrant agency data
a reuters investigation found that more than 12,000 people were arrested after the u.s. agency responsible for unaccompanied child migrants shared leads with immigration and customs enforcement. the data had been collected in the course of placing children with sponsors and relatives.

topics.headline: ICE document shows forced medical treatment of hunger-striking detainee
topics.snippet: The Guardian reviewed a newly released ICE document showing that the administration used forced medical treatment on an immigration detainee who was on hunger strike, the first such documented case. T…
topics.text:
ice document shows forced medical treatment of hunger-striking detainee
the guardian reviewed a newly released ice document showing that the administration used forced medical treatment on an immigration detainee who was on hunger strike, the first such documented case. the unnamed detainee began the strike between october and december of last year and was subject to forced feeding, hydration, forced urinary catheterisation or involuntary blood draws. international human rights groups have described such treatment as tantamount to torture and warn it carries significant medical risks.

topics.headline: Beshear demands McConnell explain absence or resign
topics.snippet: Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear sent a follow-up letter to Senator Mitch McConnell demanding an explanation of his health and absence from the Senate or his resignation. In the letter, obtained by CNN,…
topics.text:
beshear demands mcconnell explain absence or resign
kentucky governor andy beshear sent a follow-up letter to senator mitch mcconnell demanding an explanation of his health and absence from the senate or his resignation. in the letter, obtained by cnn, beshear wrote that he was addressing it to mcconnell "under the assumption that he is capable of reading and responding verbally and not incapacitated by means of consciousness or cognition." the daily beast reported the letter was also sent to senate republican leader john thune. a governor has no power to compel a senator's resignation.

topics.headline: First data center approved on BLM public land without new review
topics.snippet: The Bureau of Land Management approved a data center in Boulder City, Nevada, on public land by converting a 2023 permit for a solar and battery storage project, on the reasoning that the two uses are…
topics.text:
first data center approved on blm public land without new review
the bureau of land management approved a data center in boulder city, nevada, on public land by converting a 2023 permit for a solar and battery storage project, on the reasoning that the two uses are "substantially the same." no new environmental review or public comment period was required, and the city learned of the decision afterwards. it is the first data center ever approved on blm-managed land, and campaigners point to a parallel case in box elder county, utah, where a military land designation removed the decision from the county. a petition asks the interior department to rescind the approval, and a bill to ban data centers on federal land has been introduced.

topics.headline: Great Salt Lake near dry as new commissioner's record questioned
topics.snippet: The Great Salt Lake is all but dried up and toxic dust is blowing across northern Utah, even as residents cut water use and utilities charge premiums for heavy consumption. Some 62% of water that woul…
topics.text:
great salt lake near dry as new commissioner's record questioned
the great salt lake is all but dried up and toxic dust is blowing across northern utah, even as residents cut water use and utilities charge premiums for heavy consumption. some 62% of water that would otherwise reach the lake is diverted for human use, 71% of that goes to agriculture and 81% of the agricultural share grows hay and alfalfa, crops that account for less than 1% of utah's gdp, with an estimated third to half exported, mainly to china. governor spencer cox, an alfalfa farm owner, recently appointed farmer hannah freese as great salt lake commissioner; two years ago she was selling "make alfalfa great again" hats on facebook.

topics.headline: AI companies buying and shredding rare books to train models
topics.snippet: Reporting from Futurism and 404 Media says AI companies are bulk-buying rare and antique books, scanning them on high-speed machines that cut off the spines, and then shredding the originals. A federa…
topics.text:
ai companies buying and shredding rare books to train models
reporting from futurism and 404 media says ai companies are bulk-buying rare and antique books, scanning them on high-speed machines that cut off the spines, and then shredding the originals. a federal judge has ruled the practice is fair use on the reasoning that destroying the original keeps only one copy in existence at a time. no one in the pipeline verifies whether a given book is the last surviving copy, and local histories, self-published war memoirs and other historical records are among the material being destroyed.

topics.headline: Texas police searched 83,000 Flock cameras in abortion investigation
topics.snippet: According to 404 Media, Texas authorities searched 83,000 Flock license plate cameras nationwide in April 2025 while looking for a woman they believed had self-administered an abortion. The local sher…
topics.text:
texas police searched 83,000 flock cameras in abortion investigation
according to 404 media, texas authorities searched 83,000 flock license plate cameras nationwide in april 2025 while looking for a woman they believed had self-administered an abortion. the local sheriff said the woman's family was concerned for her safety. the searches extended to states where abortion is legal, including washington and illinois, and no charges resulted. experts warn the case shows police in states where abortion is banned can query surveillance networks in states where it is not.

topics.headline: Canadian tourism boycott costs U.S. more than $3 billion
topics.snippet: A new report from the Canadian government shows the United States has lost more than $3 billion in revenue as Canadians boycott travel south of the border. Canadian visits in July fell 30% year over y…
topics.text:
canadian tourism boycott costs u.s. more than $3 billion
a new report from the canadian government shows the united states has lost more than $3 billion in revenue as canadians boycott travel south of the border. canadian visits in july fell 30% year over year, the sharpest decline since the period after 9/11. cited causes include trump's return to office, tariffs on canada and his remarks about canadians over wildfire smoke.

topics.headline: Daily marijuana use overtakes alcohol and cigarettes in U.S.
topics.snippet: The federal National Survey on Drug Use and Health, released this week, found about 21.4 million Americans aged 12 and over report using marijuana daily or almost daily, defined as more than 20 times…
topics.text:
daily marijuana use overtakes alcohol and cigarettes in u.s.
the federal national survey on drug use and health, released this week, found about 21.4 million americans aged 12 and over report using marijuana daily or almost daily, defined as more than 20 times in a 30-day period. by comparison, 17.2 million report near-daily alcohol use and 19.9 million report near-daily cigarette use. it is the first time daily cannabis use has exceeded both.

topics.headline: Gulf states back Omani plan for voluntary Iranian fees in Strait of Hormuz
topics.snippet: Gulf states have endorsed an Omani proposal for voluntary fees paid to Iran for passage through the Strait of Hormuz, a source told Reuters. About one in five barrels of the world's oil consumption no…
topics.text:
gulf states back omani plan for voluntary iranian fees in strait of hormuz
gulf states have endorsed an omani proposal for voluntary fees paid to iran for passage through the strait of hormuz, a source told reuters. about one in five barrels of the world's oil consumption normally transits the strait.

topics.headline: Gaza yellow line expansion displaces families again
topics.snippet: Residents of Gaza say the advancing "yellow line" is forcing families to relocate once more. The shifting boundary is driving repeated displacement for households that have already moved multiple time…
topics.text:
gaza yellow line expansion displaces families again
residents of gaza say the advancing "yellow line" is forcing families to relocate once more. the shifting boundary is driving repeated displacement for households that have already moved multiple times.

topics.headline: Kremlin monitors Wildberries after Ukrainian drone strikes on warehouses
topics.snippet: Russia is monitoring the retailer Wildberries after Ukrainian drone attacks damaged eight of its warehouses since July 18, affecting more than 10% of its storage capacity. No decision on state aid for…
topics.text:
kremlin monitors wildberries after ukrainian drone strikes on warehouses
russia is monitoring the retailer wildberries after ukrainian drone attacks damaged eight of its warehouses since july 18, affecting more than 10% of its storage capacity. no decision on state aid for the company has been made.

topics.headline: U.S. drone production lags far behind Ukraine's output
topics.snippet: Ukraine is projected to produce roughly 500,000 drones per month, while cumulative Pentagon program orders stood at under 200,000 as of February. The Pentagon is pushing to build a domestic drone supp…
topics.text:
u.s. drone production lags far behind ukraine's output
ukraine is projected to produce roughly 500,000 drones per month, while cumulative pentagon program orders stood at under 200,000 as of february. the pentagon is pushing to build a domestic drone supply chain to close the gap.

topics.headline: Former Navy SEAL sentenced for plot to bomb San Diego protest
topics.snippet: Gregory Vandenberg, a 49-year-old former Navy SEAL, has been convicted and sentenced to 16 months in federal prison. Prosecutors said he plotted to attack a "No Kings" protest in San Diego with explos…
topics.text:
former navy seal sentenced for plot to bomb san diego protest
gregory vandenberg, a 49-year-old former navy seal, has been convicted and sentenced to 16 months in federal prison. prosecutors said he plotted to attack a "no kings" protest in san diego with explosives.

topics.headline: Massie says Israeli lobby spent $30 million against his campaign
topics.snippet: Representative Thomas Massie said on X that the Israeli lobby spent $30 million to defeat him but that "America won" because a generation is now aware of what he called its corrosive influence on gove…
topics.text:
massie says israeli lobby spent $30 million against his campaign
representative thomas massie said on x that the israeli lobby spent $30 million to defeat him but that "america won" because a generation is now aware of what he called its corrosive influence on government. he added that every other elected republican in congress is "bought, captured, or intimidated" to some degree and that he is the last who is not.

topics.headline: Berlin Pride attack suspect recorded pledge to Islamic State
topics.snippet: German prosecutors say the suspect in the Berlin Pride attack recorded a pledge of allegiance to Islamic State. The statement links the attack to the group as the investigation proceeds.
topics.text:
berlin pride attack suspect recorded pledge to islamic state
german prosecutors say the suspect in the berlin pride attack recorded a pledge of allegiance to islamic state. the statement links the attack to the group as the investigation proceeds.

topics.headline: Tusk urges end to xenophobic attacks on Ukrainians in Poland
topics.snippet: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called for an end to xenophobic attacks against Ukrainians following recent incidents. Hate-crime reports in Poland have been rising.
topics.text:
tusk urges end to xenophobic attacks on ukrainians in poland
polish prime minister donald tusk called for an end to xenophobic attacks against ukrainians following recent incidents. hate-crime reports in poland have been rising.

topics.headline: U.S. moves to block new Chinese robots and inverters
topics.snippet: Officials say the Trump administration plans import bans on newly introduced Chinese robot and inverter models. The measures are framed as a technology security step.
topics.text:
u.s. moves to block new chinese robots and inverters
officials say the trump administration plans import bans on newly introduced chinese robot and inverter models. the measures are framed as a technology security step.

topics.headline: City council meeting on data centers ends with mayor walking out
topics.snippet: An Inver Grove Heights City Council meeting descended into shouting ahead of a discussion of AI data centers, with residents objecting that no community input or public comment was required before the…
topics.text:
city council meeting on data centers ends with mayor walking out
an inver grove heights city council meeting descended into shouting ahead of a discussion of ai data centers, with residents objecting that no community input or public comment was required before the council approved a variance. the mayor left without answering questions from attendees.

topics.headline: Hannity eulogy praises Netanyahu and Israel ties at Graham funeral
topics.snippet: Speaking at Lindsey Graham's funeral, Sean Hannity addressed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu directly, calling him a friend of 30 years and saying Graham loved Israel and its people. Hannity said Is…
topics.text:
hannity eulogy praises netanyahu and israel ties at graham funeral
speaking at lindsey graham's funeral, sean hannity addressed prime minister benjamin netanyahu directly, calling him a friend of 30 years and saying graham loved israel and its people. hannity said israel has been one of america's most consistent and loyal allies under netanyahu's leadership and that trump has been israel's strongest friend in white house history. he also rejected characterisations of graham as a warmonger, saying graham had pressed the president for a lasting peace in the middle east.

topics.headline: Bipartisan House bill targets North Korean activities
topics.snippet: House Resolution 9963, introduced on July 27, would authorise the Secretary of State to coordinate with U.S. allies and partners to detect, attribute and disrupt certain activities of North Korea. It…
topics.text:
bipartisan house bill targets north korean activities
house resolution 9963, introduced on july 27, would authorise the secretary of state to coordinate with u.s. allies and partners to detect, attribute and disrupt certain activities of north korea. it is sponsored by representative young kim of california's 40th district with democrat ami bera of california's 6th district as co-sponsor. the bill has been referred to the foreign affairs committee and must clear hearings and markup before any vote; this congress has passed roughly 1 to 3 percent of introduced bills.

topics.headline: Nurse walks 10 miles impaled on trekking pole to avoid evacuation bill
topics.snippet: David Sephalde, a 32-year-old emergency room nurse, slipped near the summit of Montana's tallest mountain and impaled himself on his own trekking pole, leaving about eight inches protruding from each…
topics.text:
nurse walks 10 miles impaled on trekking pole to avoid evacuation bill
david sephalde, a 32-year-old emergency room nurse, slipped near the summit of montana's tallest mountain and impaled himself on his own trekking pole, leaving about eight inches protruding from each side of his body. rather than call a helicopter evacuation that would have cost thousands of dollars, he walked roughly 10 miles down to the trailhead over six and a half hours before the pole was removed. his account, highlighted by the new york times, has been widely cited as an illustration of u.s. health care costs, and he says he plans to return next year to finish the summit.
